words.verse: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י «חֹשֵׁ֛ב» עַל־ הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את רָעָ֑ה אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹֽא־ תָמִ֨ישׁוּ מִשָּׁ֜ם צַוְּארֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְלֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ רוֹמָ֔ה כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא
pills: action by which humans exercise their mind with regard to something
action by which humans or deities exercise their minds in order to determine a course of action that will achieve a certain purpose
to ask an accounting from someone else
to hold the opinion that a particular object, person, or event is to be identified with, considered similar to, or to be equated with another object, person, or event
state in which humans or deities hold the opinion that an event or situation is to be considered a particular person's responsibility

words.verse: וַיַּזְעֵ֣ק אֹתִ֔י וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר רְאֵ֗ה הַיּֽוֹצְאִים֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ «צָפ֔וֹן» הֵנִ֥יחוּ אֶת־ רוּחִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ צָפֽוֹן
pills: properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as a quarter (gloomy and unknown)
the cardinal compass point that is at 0 or 360 degrees
singular construct state form of צָפוֹן (tsafón)
The northern parts of Israel: the Galilee and the Golan Heights

words.verse: שִׁלְח֣וּ מַגָּ֔ל כִּ֥י בָשַׁ֖ל קָצִ֑יר בֹּ֤אֽוּ רְדוּ֙ כִּֽי־ מָ֣לְאָה גַּ֔ת הֵשִׁ֙יקוּ֙ הַיְקָבִ֔ים כִּ֥י «רַבָּ֖ה» רָעָתָֽם
pills: Rabbah, the name of two places in Palestine, East and West
town, also known as Rabbah of the Ammonites, ◄ and located in Ammon; ► capital of the Ammonite kingdom, first conquered by Israel on their way from Egypt, and later again by David
A female rabbi in more liberal streams of Judaism

words.verse: «נִשְׁבַּ֨ע» אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ בְּקׇדְשׁ֔וֹ כִּ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה יָמִ֖ים בָּאִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְנִשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ בְּצִנּ֔וֹת וְאַחֲרִֽיתְכֶ֖ן בְּסִיר֥וֹת דּוּגָֽה
pills: charge (by an oath, with an oath)
feed to the full (by mistake for saba`)

words.verse: וַיַּעֲנֵ֤נִי «יְהֹוָה֙» וַיֹּ֔אמֶר כְּתֹ֣ב חָז֔וֹן וּבָאֵ֖ר עַל־ הַלֻּח֑וֹת לְמַ֥עַן יָר֖וּץ ק֥וֹרֵא בֽוֹ
pills: (the) self-Existent or Eternal; Jeho-vah, Jewish national name of God
C518 ( ), or 305 ( ), in the combinations & (see ), and with preposition , , ( , , ), do not give the original form. and other follow the . On the basis of
the phrase is noteworthy: — a. after either alone
is also used with several predicates, to form sacred names of holy places of Yahweh
Tetragrammaton (the word in four Hebrew letters יהוה (in transliteration as YHWH or JHVH) used as the ineffable name of God in the Hebrew Bible, variously rendered as Yahweh or Jehovah)
The proper, personal name of the Jewish and Christian God
Transliteration of the Masoretic vocalization of the Tetragrammaton

words.verse: וַֽיַּאֲמִ֛ינוּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י «נִֽינְוֵ֖ה» בֵּֽאלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקְרְאוּ־ צוֹם֙ וַיִּלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים מִגְּדוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־ קְטַנָּֽם
pills: town; ◄ located in northern Mesopotamia near Mosul on the east bank of the Tigris; ► built by Nimrod after the flood; ancient capital of Assyria, preached against by the prophet Jonah

words.verse: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ רׇדְפ֨וֹ בַחֶ֤רֶב אָחִיו֙ וְשִׁחֵ֣ת רַחֲמָ֔יו וַיִּטְרֹ֤ף לָעַד֙ אַפּ֔וֹ וְעֶבְרָת֖וֹ «שְׁמָ֥רָהֿ» נֶֽצַח

וְאָסַפְתִּ֨י אֶת־ כׇּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם אֶֽל־ יְרוּשָׁלַ֘͏ִם֮ לַמִּלְחָמָה֒ «וְנִלְכְּדָ֣ה» הָעִ֗יר וְנָשַׁ֙סּוּ֙ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים (תשגלנה) [תִּשָּׁכַ֑בְנָה] וְיָצָ֞א חֲצִ֤י הָעִיר֙ בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה וְיֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִכָּרֵ֖ת מִן־ הָעִֽיר
שׁ֚וּבוּ לְבִצָּר֔וֹן אֲסִירֵ֖י הַתִּקְוָ֑ה גַּם־ «הַיּ֕וֹם» מַגִּ֥יד מִשְׁנֶ֖ה אָשִׁ֥יב לָֽךְ
חֲז֖וֹן עֹֽבַדְיָ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יֱהֹוִ֜ה «לֶאֱד֗וֹם» שְׁמוּעָ֨ה שָׁמַ֜עְנוּ מֵאֵ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ וְצִיר֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם שֻׁלָּ֔ח ק֛וּמוּ וְנָק֥וּמָה עָלֶ֖יהָ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה
הִנְנִ֣י מְעִירָ֔ם מִ֨ן־ הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם «שָׁ֑מָּה» וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י גְמֻֽלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם
